**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include claim conflicts in material snapshots**

When a second current, admitted claim disagrees on tier, MW, timing, duration, or supply, `project_state()` now correctly reports `CONFLICT`, but this snapshot still records only the mutable `PowerNeed` values. If deterministic claim selection leaves those values unchanged, `record_material_diff()` emits no event; if selection changes, it records a replacement rather than the unresolved contradiction. Consequently `/api/changes` and project change history can omit or misrepresent the arrival of material conflicting evidence; derive the snapshot from the evidence-aware field projection so conflict transitions are persisted.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/cf0662eb7b19e9ec17c3fcc510c00f402d72fca7/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)
